name: Technical / design review
description: Record options, trade-offs, design decisions, and outstanding verification work.

sections.title: Review scope
sections.instruction: Describe the technical problem, constraints, and success criteria discussed. Cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Options and trade-offs
sections.instruction: List the options considered and the reasons given for each. Distinguish observed results from expectations and cite a supplied source tag beside each point

sections.title: Decisions and rationale
sections.instruction: List accepted, rejected, and deferred decisions with their stated rationale. Identify proposals as proposals and cite the supplied source tags

sections.title: Action items
sections.instruction: List agreed changes and verification work. Include explicitly stated owners and dates, and copy the supplied source tag beside each task
sections.item_format: - Task in one sentence. Owner: name or Unassigned; Due: date or Not specified

sections.title: Open risks
sections.instruction: List unresolved risks, assumptions, and questions with the supplied source tags that support them
